NOT FOUND: any published rule for engineering-background applicants.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. 2026-27 calendar (marked as 2026-27, NOT shifted forward): Ordinario — solicitud 20 mayo – 22 junio 2026; 1ª lista 3 julio 2026, matrícula 6–14 julio 2026; further lists 16/23/29 julio 2026. Excepcional — 15 septiembre – 1 octubre 2026 y 15 octubre 2026 – 28 enero 2027 (the January window applies only to másteres of more than 60 ECTS with vacancies, so NOT this 60-ECTS title). notes: RUCT code confirmed from output/ruct-detail.jsonl + RUCT deep link (the register title matches the target title and university exactly); the programme's own pages checked do NOT print a 'Código RUCT' line. ⚠️ NAME-COLLISION TRAP: there is a second, DIFFERENT programme with a near-identical name — 'Máster de Formación Permanente en Procesamiento del Lenguaje e Inteligencia Artificial (online)' run by the Fundación Universidad de La Rioja (fundacion.unirioja.es/formacion_cursos/view/516/). Also distinct from Universidad Internacional de La Rioja (UNIR), a different institution. Fee arithmetic shown: 47.94 x 60 = 2,876.40 (non-EU); 24.61 x 60 = 1,476.60 (resident). tuition_total_eur: EUR 9,424.80 (2026-27 rates) — non-EU non-resident. Arithmetic: UPV publishes 39.27 EUR/credit for this title; the Comunitat Valenciana rule applies 'x2' to non-EU non-residents, so 39.27 x 2 = 78.54 EUR/credit x 120 ECTS = 9,424.80. EU/resident equivalent is 39.27 x 120 = EUR 4,712.40 ('Desde 4712,4 €' on the UPV page). ⚠️ CAVEAT: for an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master the consortium normally sets its own participation costs rather than the national per-credit tariff, and EMJM scholarship holders may not be charged participation costs at all. NOT FOUND: any consortium-published participation-cost figure — master-waves.eu publishes none, and its application platform is down (see application_window_2027).
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and large. UPV's own 2026/2027 matrícula page states verbatim: 'Al estudiantado de nuevo ingreso extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se les aplicará 2 veces los precios'. Set by Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, modifying Decreto 101/2024 de 2 de agosto (Generalitat Valenciana) — this RAISED the non-EU multiplier from +50% to x2 (i.e. +100%) for 2026-27. Residency: a Spanish long-stay study authorisation does not confer resident status, so this candidate cannot escape it (RD 557/2011 referenced by UPV).
complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (null in the register extract — this is NOT the same as 0). (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: NOT FOUND. The UPV titulaciones page gives no complementos de formación detail, and the consortium's own admission pages are unreachable (404 / platform withdrawn), so no applicant-level bridging rule could be established. Note that at 120 ECTS this is a two-year title, so a 300-ECTS entrant has no bridging problem but also no published advanced-standing route — NOT FOUND on credit recognition.
application_window_2027: ⚠️ APPEARS NOT TO RUN FOR A 2027 INTAKE — this is the most consequential finding on this record. The WAVES Consortium Committee announced on 1 October 2025 that it is reworking the programme and DECIDED NOT TO OPEN THE RECRUITMENT CAMPAIGN FOR A 2026-2028 COHORT; the consortium site states 'The application platform is therefore unavailable' and /applications and /admission now return HTTP 404. UPV's own titulaciones page independently shows places offered as 'No disponible (curso 26-27)' and the title as 'Título en proceso de renovación'. NO 2027-2029 cohort has been announced. For completeness, UPV's GENERIC master admission phases for curso 2026-27 (marked 2026-27, NOT shifted forward, and NOT confirmed to apply to this title given no places are offered): Fase 0 (international students from outside the EU) 17 noviembre 2025 – 13 febrero 2026; Fase 1 (all) 2 marzo – 30 abril 2026; Fase 2 (all) 15–26 junio 2026; Fase 3 (all) 31 julio – 7 agosto y 24 agosto – 4 septiembre 2026. NOTE the Fase 0 non-EU early round: UPV does run a dedicated earlier window for extracomunitarios.
notes: RUCT code confirmed from the RUCT deep link and output/ruct-detail.jsonl; the register title names all four consortium institutions and matches exactly. UPV's page links to RUCT but does not print the code inline. The register still lists the title as active and 'Publicado en B.O.E.' — but REGISTRY PRESENCE IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING OPEN: two independent primary sources (the consortium and UPV) say no cohort is being recruited. RECOMMEND treating this as CLOSED for September 2027 unless the consortium reopens. Fee arithmetic shown: 39.27 x 120 = 4,712.40 (EU/resident); 39.27 x 2 x 120 = 9,424.80 (non-EU). Note this is one of only two English-taught titles in this batch of nine.

complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (null in the register extract — NOT the same as 0). (b) FOR THE APPLICANT, from UEMC's own 'Acceso y Admisión' page: NO complementos de formación are imposed. Instead there are two access routes. ACCESO 1 (direct): Grado/licenciatura in Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería Electrónica, Física, Estadística or Matemáticas — and 'También pueden acceder al master los titulados universitarios en estas mismas especialidades de sistemas universitarios extranjeros SIN NECESIDAD DE HOMOLOGACIÓN de sus títulos', subject to the university verifying an equivalent level. ACCESO 2 (other ICT degrees): must evidence at least 1.5 years' professional experience plus solid knowledge in software development, database management systems and systems work; Comisión de Admisiones rules within 48 hours and may require an interview. A Software Engineering degree from a foreign system falls under ACCESO 1 as an Ingeniería Informática-equivalent, subject to UEMC's level check — this is the ONE programme in this batch with an explicit no-homologación clause. UEMC also runs a separate 'Reconocimiento académico de créditos' service, relevant to the 300-ECTS question, but publishes no rule for it on the pages checked.
application_window_2027: NO DATED APPLICATION WINDOW IS PUBLISHED FOR ONLINE NEW ENTRANTS — admission is rolling/continuous. UEMC's admission page for this title describes a self-service flow with no dates: request information → 'Cumplimenta la Automatrícula online' → the university checks admission requirements from the documents supplied. The only dated calendar UEMC publishes (Fechas de Matriculación 2026-2027, marked 2026-27 and NOT shifted forward) is for RETURNING students: 'PARA ALUMNOS DE TITULACIONES ONLINE — Los alumnos de segundo curso y sucesivos ... desde el 1 de julio hasta el 21 de septiembre' (extraordinaria from 4 August to 21 September). Its presencial-track equivalent is 22 June–31 August 2026. A separate press-reported date — preinscripción for PRESENCIAL másteres 2026-27 opening 2 February at 09:00 — does not apply to this online title. 2027-28 dates not published.
